### Specification PR
_This pull request only adds or changes specifications in `specs/`. It is reviewed for content and feasibility, not for code._

### Short description
_What does this spec describe, and why is it needed? Link the related issue._

### Scope
- Spec file(s): _e.g. `specs/<topic>.md`_
- Affected IAMC variables / features: _list them_

### Sources
_List the sources the spec relies on (variable definitions in `sister_packages/energy-scenarios-at-workflow/definitions`, existing code, PyPSA docs, ...)._

### Open questions and assumptions
_List anything that needs a decision from the reviewer._

---
### Checklist
- [ ] Only files under `specs/` are changed.
- [ ] Every factual claim (variables, carriers, units, files) is backed by a cited source; nothing is invented.
- [ ] Return format, units and sign conventions are specified where relevant.
- [ ] Acceptance criteria are concrete enough to be turned into unit tests.
- [ ] Open questions and assumptions are listed explicitly.
